hooks.command: file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); case "$file" in */.env|*/.env.*|*/yarn.lock) echo "Blocked: $file must not be edited by Claude. Edit manually if needed."; exit 2 ;; esac

file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); case "$file" in *.vue|*.ts|*.js|*.mjs) cd /Users/angelibarra/code/newcastle-lgbt && ./node_modules/.bin/eslint --fix "$file" 2>&1 | tail -20 ;; esac; exit 0

file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); case "$file" in */content/*.md) count=$(grep -c '—' "$file" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); [ "$count" -gt 0 ] && echo "WARNING: $count em dash(es) in $file — replace with commas or colons" ;; esac; exit 0

file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); case "$file" in */content/news/*.md) matches=$(grep -niE 'nothing left to lose|least to lose|lot to lose|quietly (removed|deleted)|militancy|legally armed|outlandish|masquerading as|threw the first (punch|brick)|first punches|discarded entirely|criminal indifference' "$file" 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$matches" ] && echo "REMINDER: possible editorial-checklist issue(s) in $file, see docs/editorial-checklist.md:\n$matches" ;; esac; exit 0

file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); [ -f "$file" ] && matches=$(grep -n 'https://newcastle\.lgbt/' "$file" 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$matches" ] && echo "WARNING: absolute internal URL(s) in $file — use relative paths instead:\n$matches"; exit 0

file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); case "$file" in *.vue) matches=$(grep -n ':class=' "$file" 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$matches" ] && echo "REMINDER: dynamic :class binding(s) in $file may need adding to PurgeCSS safelist in nuxt.config.ts:\n$matches" ;; esac; exit 0

cd /Users/angelibarra/code/newcastle-lgbt && changed=$(git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\.(vue|ts|js|mjs)$'); [ -n "$changed" ] && echo "Reminder: source files changed — run 'make lint' then 'make build' to verify."; exit 0
